_doc.what: The ops loop's watchlist (design: references/ops-loop.md in the tdd skill). Copy to ~/.system-design/ops/watchlist.json and fill it. Read by the dispatcher session on start and by the local scheduled tasks on every run; none of them ever edits it. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
_doc.version: Shape version; readers refuse a version they do not know.
_doc.defaults: Merged under every entry; grants merge key by key.
_doc.defaults.host: LocalHostName (scutil --get LocalHostName) of the machine that serves an entry. Exactly one machine serves an artifact, so two dispatchers never answer one thread.
_doc.defaults.model: Model pinned on each responder subagent (opus | sonnet). The dispatcher's own model caps start_session side sessions (same family or cheaper).
_doc.defaults.max_parallel: Responder subagents at once, and candidate threads per artifact per scheduled run.
_doc.defaults.max_replies_per_hour: Per artifact; counted from the run log.
_doc.defaults.usage_ceiling_pct: Weekly usage at or over this: reply to nothing, log 'skipped: usage ceiling' (95 is the lead's standing ceiling since 2026-11-05).
_doc.defaults.stale_minutes: For responder 'dispatcher' entries, the scheduled task answers a thread only after it has waited this long (the dispatcher missed it).
_doc.defaults.grants: What a responder may do. answer = reply, resolve, log. edit_source = edit the packet's source files, rebuild, lint, check (never build/ by hand). republish = publish the rebuilt page to the same private artifact URL. draft_pr = push a feature branch and open a draft PR. github_comment, linear_comment = post there. Never grantable: deploy or launch, merge, push to main, sharing or permission changes, account settings, database writes, recording a D-number, creating or changing scheduled tasks or routines.
_doc.state_file: Local cursors (linear_cursor). Written by the local Linear poll.
_doc.run_log_dir: One <YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl per UTC day: one object per handled signal.
_doc.artifacts[].url: The artifact_url line of the packet's status.md. Placeholder until the TDD is published.
_doc.artifacts[].account: personal | work: the claude.ai account that owns the artifact; the serving machine must be signed in with it.
_doc.artifacts[].owner_edits: true only when the owner can edit the artifact (an Artifact read says 'writer'). Auto-replies are armed only then.
_doc.artifacts[].responder: dispatcher = a live dispatcher session holds the watch and the scheduled task is the safety net; poll = only the scheduled task answers.
_doc.artifacts[].packet: The packet root. status_doc and agents_lane are relative to it; write_agents.py writes the lane to build/agents by default.
_doc.artifacts[].repo: Local checkout the design cites; responders read it at meta.json's sha.
_doc.artifacts[].mcps: MCP servers a responder may call, read-only unless a grant says otherwise. host:<name> servers are reachable only on the serving machine (and from a page only for the owner, in the desktop app).
_doc.artifacts[].github: repo (owner/name), tokens that summon the responder on a PR, desk_label the cloud routine adds when it routes a question to the local desk.
_doc.artifacts[].linear: team, label and tokens the Linear poll matches (tokens also match the slug with a D- or Q-number in a comment).
